    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '391114-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the set's own inventory parts (direct parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        0 AS nesting_level,
        'direct' AS source_type
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: nested sets and minifigs
    -- Nested sets
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (e.qty * iset.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
        e.nesting_level + 1,
        'nested' AS source_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN (

        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.source_type = 'direct' AND e.nesting_level = 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (e.qty * im.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
        e.nesting_level + 1,
        'nested' AS source_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (

    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.source_type = 'direct' AND e.nesting_level = 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Deeper nesting: nested sets within nested sets/minifigs
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

        WHERE i2.set_num = (

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.source_type = 'nested'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Deeper nesting: minifigs within nested sets
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,

        e.nesting_level + 1,
        'nested' AS source_type

        WHERE i2.set_num = (

            )
        )
    )
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.source_type = 'nested'
),
-- Simpler approach: use a proper recursive traversal
-- First, get all inventory IDs we need to traverse
inventory_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        1 AS multiplier,
        0 AS level,
        'root' AS item_type
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '391114-1'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '391114-1')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find nested sets and minifigs in current inventories
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        (it.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity)) AS multiplier,
        it.level + 1,
        CASE WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END AS item_type
    FROM inventory_tree it
    JOIN inventories parent_inv ON parent_inv.id = it.inventory_id
    -- Join to nested sets
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = parent_inv.id
    LEFT JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = iset.set_num
        AND child_inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num)
    -- Join to minifigs
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = parent_inv.id
    LEFT JOIN inventories child_inv2 ON child_inv2.set_num = im.fig_num
        AND child_inv2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    WHERE it.level < 10  -- prevent infinite loops
      AND (child_inv.id IS NOT NULL OR child_inv2.id IS NOT NULL)
),
-- Get all parts with their multipliers
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        SUM(ip.quantity * it.multiplier) AS total_qty,
        CASE WHEN it.level = 0 THEN 'direct' ELSE 'nested' END AS source
    FROM inventory_tree it
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = it.inventory_id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    GROUP BY ip.part_num, ip.color_id, CASE WHEN it.level = 0 THEN 'direct' ELSE 'nested' END
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'nested' THEN total_qty ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(total_qty), 0),
        2
    ) AS percentage_from_nested
FROM all_parts;
